greek_phrase: ἐβάρυνεν Φαραω τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: Pharaoh made his heart heavy also at this time
alternate_renderings: Pharaoh said I will let you go
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint hardening notice at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic speech verse.

greek_phrase: συγγενεῖς γάρ σού εἰσιν· ἀσέβημά ἐστιν
chosen_rendering: they are your own kin. It is impiety
alternate_renderings: they are her near kinswomen; it is wickedness
rationale: Keeps the Greek kinship orientation and impiety term.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἔθηκαν ἐπ’ αὐτὸ κλωστῆρα ὑάκινθον ... ἐπὶ τὴν κίδαριν ἄνωθεν
chosen_rendering: they placed on it blue cord so that it would be on turban above
alternate_renderings: five pillars and hooks overlaid with gold
rationale: Keeps Septuagint turban-cord line at this numbering point rather than Masoretic pillar verse.

greek_phrase: οὕτως λέγει κύριος· Ὡς σὺ πεφόνευκας καὶ κεκληρονόμηκας
chosen_rendering: thus says Lord: As you murdered and inherited
alternate_renderings: these young men of princes of provinces came out of city
rationale: Keeps Septuagint Naboth judgment oracle at this numbering point rather than Masoretic battle movement verse.

greek_phrase: ἵνα μάθωσιν φοβεῖσθαί με ... καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν διδάξουσιν
chosen_rendering: so that they may learn to fear me ... and teach their sons
alternate_renderings: that they may teach their children
rationale: Keeps Greek sons wording and direct assembly framing.

greek_phrase: τὸ δὲ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χαλκοῦν ἔσται μοι εἰς τὸ πρωί
chosen_rendering: bronze altar will be for me to inquire by
alternate_renderings: brazen altar shall be for me in morning
rationale: Keeps the project's established rendering for the Greek closing clause.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἀπεστράφησαν τοῦ μὴ πορεύεσθαι
chosen_rendering: turned back from not going against Ieroboam
alternate_renderings: returned from going against Jeroboam
rationale: Keeps the Greek turned-back phrase close to the text.

greek_phrase: ἀπὸ ἀρχῆς τοῦ σαββάτου ἕως τέλους τοῦ σαββάτου
chosen_rendering: from beginning of Sabbath to end of Sabbath
alternate_renderings: that were to come in on sabbath with those to go out on sabbath
rationale: Keeps the Greek time-span formulation.

greek_phrase: τὰ ἐπίλοιπα ὑάκινθος καὶ πορφύρα καὶ κόκκινον
chosen_rendering: remaining blue and purple and scarlet
alternate_renderings: third row a jacinth an agate and an amethyst
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint garment-material line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic gemstone row.

greek_phrase: καὶ καθίσαι ἐν τῷ τόπῳ αὐτῆς
chosen_rendering: let it sit in its place
alternate_renderings: let it go again to its own place
rationale: Keeps the Greek sitting/resting wording.

greek_phrase: καὶ περιεῖλεν τὰ θυσιαστήρια τῶν ἀλλοτρίων
chosen_rendering: he removed altars of foreigners
alternate_renderings: Asa did what was good and right
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint reform-action line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic summary.

greek_phrase: καὶ κατεχρύσωσεν αὐτὸ χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ ἔσωθεν καὶ ἔξωθεν
chosen_rendering: overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside
alternate_renderings: overlaid it with brass
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint gold-overlay line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic bronze-horns verse.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐνετειλάμην τὰ παιδάρια εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν λεγόμενον θεοῦ πίστις, Φελλανι, Ἀλεμωνι
chosen_rendering: I have directed young men to place called God’s faith Phellani Alemoni
alternate_renderings: what is under your hand give me five loaves
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint royal-mission explanation and difficult place-name phrase at this numbering point.

greek_phrase: τοὺς τάφους τοὺς ἐκεῖ ἐν τῇ πόλει
chosen_rendering: tombs there in the city
alternate_renderings: sepulchers there in the mount
rationale: Keeps the Greek city wording.

greek_phrase: αἱ ἡμέραι αἱ πρότεραι ἄλογοι ἔσονται
chosen_rendering: former days shall be without account
alternate_renderings: former days shall be lost
rationale: Keeps the Greek accounting image.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ἡραμ
chosen_rendering: sons of Heram
alternate_renderings: children of Harim
rationale: Keeps the Greek proper-name form in returnee register.

greek_phrase: ἀπὸ πόλεως ὀχυρᾶς καὶ ἕως κώμης τοῦ Φερεζαίου
chosen_rendering: from fortified city and to village of the Perizzite
alternate_renderings: both of fenced cities and of country villages
rationale: Keeps the Greek village-of-the-Perizzite wording.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ἐδιν
chosen_rendering: sons of Edin
alternate_renderings: children of Adin
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in Nehemiah register.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ἡραμ
chosen_rendering: sons of Heram
alternate_renderings: children of Harim
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in Nehemiah register.

greek_phrase: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὸν οἶκον τοῦ δρυμοῦ τοῦ Λιβάνου
chosen_rendering: he built House of Forest of Lebanon
alternate_renderings: he put five bases on right side of house
rationale: Keeps Septuagint palace-building line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic basin-base verse.

greek_phrase: Χαμααμ διαβήσεται μετ’ ἐμοῦ
chosen_rendering: Chamaam shall cross with me
alternate_renderings: all people went over Jordan and king kissed Barzillai
rationale: Keeps Septuagint Chimham line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic departure notice.

greek_phrase: μήτε τὸ σπέρμα μου μήτε τὸ ὄνομά μου
chosen_rendering: nor my seed nor my name
alternate_renderings: nor my son nor my son's son
rationale: Keeps the Greek seed/name pairing rather than the Masoretic generational phrasing.

greek_phrase: ξυλεία ... καταστεγάσαι τὰς πύλας
chosen_rendering: timbers to roof the gates
alternate_renderings: timber to make beams for the gates
rationale: Keeps the Greek roofing verb rather than recasting to beams.

greek_phrase: ἑκατὸν τάλαντα ἀργυρίου ἐγενήθη εἰς τὴν χώνευσιν τῶν ἑκατὸν κεφαλίδων
chosen_rendering: one hundred talents of silver became casting of one hundred capitals of tent
alternate_renderings: they made shoulder pieces for it
rationale: Keeps Septuagint silver-capitals accounting line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic ephod-shoulder verse.

greek_phrase: ἀνὴρ οὐ σύ
lemma: καὶ τίς ὡς σύ ἐν Ἰσραηλ;ἀνήρ
chosen_rendering: are you not a man and who is like you in Israel
alternate_renderings: art not thou a valiant man
rationale: Keeps the Greek rebuke direct without supplying valiant.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ααρων ... καὶ ἔδραμεν εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν
chosen_rendering: Aaron took it and ran into congregation
alternate_renderings: children of Israel said behold we die
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint plague-atonement line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic complaint verse.

greek_phrase: οὐ μὴ θελήσῃ ὁ θεὸς ἱλάσασθαι αὐτῷ
chosen_rendering: God will certainly not be willing to be propitiated toward him
alternate_renderings: Lord will not spare him
rationale: Keeps the Greek propitiation language rather than reducing it to a simpler spare idiom.

greek_phrase: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀγγέλοις υἱοῦ Αδερ
chosen_rendering: he said to messengers of son of Ader
alternate_renderings: she wrote in letters proclaim fast
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Ben-hadad messenger exchange at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Jezebel letter verse.

greek_phrase: ὁ τόπος Δαυιδ ἐπεσκέπη
chosen_rendering: David’s place was inspected
alternate_renderings: David's place was empty
rationale: Keeps the Greek verb of looking in on or examining the place.

greek_phrase: ζῶν εὑρεθῇ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: stolen thing is found alive in his hand
alternate_renderings: if sun be risen upon him there shall be blood shed
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint restitution line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic burglary ruling.

greek_phrase: μὴ λογισάσθω ὁ κύριός μου ἀνομίαν ἐμοί
chosen_rendering: let not my lord reckon lawlessness against me
alternate_renderings: for your servant knows that I have sinned
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint plea at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic confession line.

greek_phrase: οὐκ ἔστιν ἀντίδικος καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐντύχημα πονηρόν
chosen_rendering: there is no adversary and there is no evil encounter
alternate_renderings: builders of Solomon and Hiram hewed them
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint rest-and-security verse at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic building-work line.

greek_phrase: ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ ἑβδόμῳ Ἰου
chosen_rendering: in seventh year of Iou
alternate_renderings: Jehoash did what was right
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint accession notice at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic evaluation line.

greek_phrase: τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσων ἀπὸ τῶν συγγενειῶν ἡμίσεος φυλῆς Μανασση
chosen_rendering: to sons of Gedson from families of half tribe of Manasse
alternate_renderings: but fields of the city and villages thereof they gave to Caleb
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint allotment line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Caleb note.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Φασσουρ
chosen_rendering: sons of Phassour
alternate_renderings: children of Pashur
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in register.

greek_phrase: τῆς προθέσεως ... τοὺς ἄρτους τῆς παρουσίας
chosen_rendering: loaves of presentation ... breads of the presence
alternate_renderings: Doeg the Edomite was there that day
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint holy-bread line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Doeg notice.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Φασσουρ
chosen_rendering: sons of Phassour
alternate_renderings: children of Pashur
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in returnee register.

greek_phrase: ἐποίησαν τὸ λογεῖον τετράγωνον διπλοῦν
chosen_rendering: they made breastpiece square and doubled
alternate_renderings: he coupled five curtains by themselves and six by themselves
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint breastpiece line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic curtain-joining verse.

greek_phrase: ἀπὸ μέρους τοῦ χειμάρρου
chosen_rendering: from middle part of ravine
alternate_renderings: from middle of the river
rationale: Keeps the Greek ravine wording rather than normalizing to river.

greek_phrase: δοκιμάσαι αὐτὴν καὶ κατασκοπεῦσαι αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπισκέψασθαι αὐτήν
chosen_rendering: search the city and spy it out and inspect it
alternate_renderings: search city and spy it out and overthrow it
rationale: Keeps the Greek triad without importing overthrow.

greek_phrase: Σασαβασαρ τὸν γαζοφύλακα τὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ γαζοφυλακίου
chosen_rendering: Sasabasar the treasurer over the treasury
alternate_renderings: Sheshbazzar whom he had made governor
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint treasury-office wording rather than the Masoretic governor title.

greek_phrase: ἀφελεῖτε ἀφαίρεμα κυρίου
chosen_rendering: you shall remove Lord's contribution
alternate_renderings: you shall offer an heave offering unto Lord
rationale: Keeps the Greek remove/set-apart wording.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ἁρα
chosen_rendering: sons of Hara
alternate_renderings: children of Arah
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in register.

greek_phrase: τοῖς Μαζουρωθ
chosen_rendering: to the Mazouroth
alternate_renderings: to the planets
rationale: Keeps the Greek celestial term transliterated rather than interpreting it.

greek_phrase: στάχυας ... δρέπανον
chosen_rendering: gather ears with your hands ... not put sickle to standing grain
alternate_renderings: pluck ears with hand ... not move sickle unto standing corn
rationale: Keeps the Greek ear/sickle pair in direct form.

greek_phrase: ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ προσφέρων αὐτὴν φάγεται αὐτήν
chosen_rendering: priest who offers it shall eat it
alternate_renderings: Lord spoke unto Moses saying
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint priestly-eating line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic speech heading.

greek_phrase: ἀμπελῶνας καὶ ἐλαιῶνας
chosen_rendering: vineyards and olive groves
alternate_renderings: vineyards and olive yards
rationale: Keeps the Greek pair in standard English.

greek_phrase: μετ’ αὐτοῦ πεντήκοντα ἄνδρες ἀπὸ τῶν τετρακοσίων
chosen_rendering: with him were fifty men from the four hundred
alternate_renderings: with him fifty men of the Gileadites
rationale: Keeps the Greek group designation rather than importing the Masoretic reading.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Μωυσῆς πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραηλ
chosen_rendering: Moses called all sons of Israel
alternate_renderings: these are words of covenant
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint historical opening at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic covenant heading.

greek_phrase: καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν τῆς προθέσεως καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τοὺς ἐπικειμένους
chosen_rendering: presentation table and all its utensils and the loaves laid out
alternate_renderings: they put two chains of gold in rings on ends of breastplate
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint tabernacle-furnishing line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic breastplate-chain verse.

greek_phrase: ἐν καιρῷ τοῦ μηνὸς τῶν νέων
chosen_rendering: at time of month of new grain
alternate_renderings: in time appointed of month Abib
rationale: Keeps the Greek calendrical phrasing rather than supplying the Hebrew month name.

greek_phrase: τῷ Νεφθαλι ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος ὁ ἕκτος
chosen_rendering: for Naphtali the sixth lot came out
alternate_renderings: sixth lot came out to children of Naphtali according to families
rationale: Keeps the Greek concise lot notice.

greek_phrase: ἐν τῷ συναγαγεῖν με τοὺς πυλωρούς
chosen_rendering: when I was gathering the gatekeepers
alternate_renderings: porter list keeping ward at thresholds of gates
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint first-person gathering note at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic name list.

greek_phrase: Ἰωας ἑπτὰ ἐτῶν ἐβασίλευσεν
chosen_rendering: Ioas was seven years old when he became king
alternate_renderings: in seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign and forty years reigned
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint accession summary at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic fuller regnal formula.

greek_phrase: Εἶδες πῶς κατενύγη Αχααβ ἀπὸ προσώπου μου
chosen_rendering: have you seen how Achaab was pierced to heart from before me
alternate_renderings: they camped one opposite another seven days and battle joined
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Ahab-judgment line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic battle summary.

greek_phrase: ἐκάθισεν ἐν τοῖς στενοῖς Εγγαδδι
chosen_rendering: sat in the narrow places of Engaddi
alternate_renderings: Saul returned from following Philistines and was told David in wilderness of Engedi
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint dwelling-place line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic notice to Saul.

greek_phrase: ἡ καρδία Ναβαλ ἀγαθὴ ἐπ’ αὐτόν
chosen_rendering: heart of Nabal was good upon him
alternate_renderings: Nabal's heart was merry within him
rationale: Keeps the Greek idiom rather than smoothing it to merry.

greek_phrase: συνῆψεν τὸ λογεῖον ἐκ τῶν δακτυλίων αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς δακτυλίους τοῦ ἐπωμίδος
chosen_rendering: he fastened breastpiece from its rings to rings of ephod
alternate_renderings: he made two boards for corners of tabernacle
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint breastpiece-fastening line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic board verse.

greek_phrase: Σαλωμωθ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάντων τῶν θησαυρῶν τῶν ἁγίων
chosen_rendering: This Salōmōth and his brothers were over all treasuries of holy things
alternate_renderings: which Shelomith and his brethren were over all treasures of dedicated things
rationale: Keeps the Greek holy-things phrasing.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις τῆς πόλεως ἕως πύλης Εφραιμ
chosen_rendering: in the broad places of the city even to Gate of Ephraim
alternate_renderings: in street of water gate and in street of gate of Ephraim
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint city-broad-places line at this numbering point.

greek_phrase: ὀπίσω τίνος σὺ καταδιώκεις; ὀπίσω κυνὸς τεθνηκότος καὶ ὀπίσω ψύλλου ἑνός
chosen_rendering: after whom do you pursue? after dead dog and after one flea
alternate_renderings: Lord be judge and plead my cause
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint rhetorical taunt at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic appeal-to-judgment line.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἀπολοῦσί σε
chosen_rendering: until they utterly destroy you and until they perish you
alternate_renderings: till thou be destroyed
rationale: Keeps the doubled Greek destruction phrasing visible.

greek_phrase: Μααζια Βελγαι Σαμαια· οὗτοι ἱερεῖς
chosen_rendering: Maazia Belgai Samaia. These were priests
alternate_renderings: Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah etc.
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint priest list at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Levite list.

greek_phrase: ἀργυρόχρυσα ἦν
chosen_rendering: they also were silver-covered
alternate_renderings: six branches going out of sides thereof
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint pin-and-overlay line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic lampstand-branch verse.

greek_phrase: Ελκανα καὶ Ἰησουνι καὶ Οζριηλ καὶ Ἰωαζαρ καὶ Ἰεσβοαμ οἱ Κοριται
chosen_rendering: Elkana and Iēsouni and Ozriēl and Iōazar and Iesboam the Korites
alternate_renderings: Joelah and Zebadiah sons of Jeroham of Gedor
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint name list at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic one.

greek_phrase: καθισάτω δὴ ὁ παῖς σου κἀγὼ ἀποθανοῦμαι ἐν τῇ πόλει μου
chosen_rendering: let your servant sit now and I will die in my city
alternate_renderings: king answered Chimham shall go over with me
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Barzillai request at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic royal reply.

greek_phrase: ἐγὼ σήμερον ὀγδοήκοντα ἐτῶν
chosen_rendering: I am eighty years old today
alternate_renderings: your servant will go little way over Jordan with king
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Barzillai speech at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic shorter travel line.

greek_phrase: τίς ἡμῖν μερὶς ἐν Δαυιδ καὶ κληρονομία ἐν υἱῷ Ιεσσαι
chosen_rendering: what share do we have in Dauid and inheritance in son of Iessai
alternate_renderings: what portion have we in David and no inheritance in son of Jesse
rationale: Keeps the Greek revolt cry close to its wording.

greek_phrase: Ἰουδα εἶπεν ἐθραύσθη ἰσχὺς τῶν ἐχθρῶν
chosen_rendering: Iouda said strength of enemies was crushed
alternate_renderings: Hear O our God for we are despised
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint wall-building report at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic prayer verse.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Βαγοι
chosen_rendering: sons of Bagoi
alternate_renderings: children of Bigvai
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in returnee register.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Βανουι
chosen_rendering: sons of Banoui
alternate_renderings: children of Binnui
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in register.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐπάρας τῇ ῥάβδῳ ἐπάταξεν τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ
chosen_rendering: lifting up his staff he struck the water in the river
alternate_renderings: Aaron having lifted up his hand with his rod smote the water
rationale: Keeps fresh project rendering staff and direct narrative flow.

greek_phrase: ἐν ἑνὶ τῶν βουνῶν ἢ ἐν ἑνὶ τῶν τόπων
chosen_rendering: in one of the hills or in one of the places
alternate_renderings: in some pit or in some other place
rationale: Keeps Greek hill/place wording rather than replacing it with pit.

greek_phrase: τὸ αὐτόματον καὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ τὸ ἀνατέλλον
chosen_rendering: this year what grows of itself and in second year the springing growth
alternate_renderings: such things as grow of themselves and in second year that which springs of same
rationale: Keeps the Greek pair of spontaneous growth expressions.

greek_phrase: τὸ ὑπόδημα τὸ ἀπὸ τοῦ ποδὸς αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: his sandal the one on his foot
alternate_renderings: loose one shoe from off his foot
rationale: Keeps Greek sandal wording.

greek_phrase: ἀποκαλύψω τὸ οὖς σου
chosen_rendering: I will uncover your ear
alternate_renderings: I thought to advertise you
rationale: Keeps Greek ear-uncovering idiom instead of paraphrasing it away.

greek_phrase: οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ οὕτως ἐποίησαν
chosen_rendering: sons of Israel did as Lord commanded Moses so they did
alternate_renderings: they set in it four rows of stones
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint obedience-summary line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic gemstone verse.

greek_phrase: ὧν ἐφέροντο ἡ διάνοια αὐτῶν εἰσελθόντες ποιεῖν
chosen_rendering: whose mind moved them to come in and do all works
alternate_renderings: whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work
rationale: Keeps the Greek mind-and-entering phrasing close to the text.

greek_phrase: Διὰ τί λαλεῖς ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ τείχους
chosen_rendering: why do you speak in ears of people upon wall
alternate_renderings: talk not with us in Jews' language in ears of people on wall
rationale: Keeps the Greek rebuke question explicit.

greek_phrase: καὶ τὰς δέκα μέχωνοθ καὶ τοὺς δέκα λουτῆρας ἐπὶ τῶν μέχωνοθ
chosen_rendering: ten stands and ten wash-basins upon stands
alternate_renderings: on the borders between ledges were lions oxen and cherubims
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint list line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic decorative description.

greek_phrase: σχεδίας κατὰ θάλασσαν εἰς Ιοππην
chosen_rendering: on rafts by sea to Ioppē
alternate_renderings: now therefore wheat barley oil and wine let him send
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint timber-shipping line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic supplies request.

greek_phrase: ἐκκενώσωσιν τὴν οἰκίαν
chosen_rendering: empty the house
alternate_renderings: remove the furniture of the house
rationale: Keeps the stronger Greek empty-house command.

greek_phrase: καὶ αὗται αἱ δικαιοσύναι καὶ τὰ κρίματα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο κύριος τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
chosen_rendering: and these are ordinances and judgments Lord commanded sons of Israel in wilderness
alternate_renderings: Hear O Israel the Lord our God is one Lord
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint prefatory line before the Shema at this numbering point.

greek_phrase: ἔστρεψεν καρδίαν βασιλέως Ασσουρ ἐπ’ αὐτούς
chosen_rendering: turned heart of king of Assour toward them
alternate_renderings: turned heart of king of Assyria unto them
rationale: Keeps Greek name form Assour.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ μέρους τοῦ πρὸς βορρᾶν ἑκατὸν ἐφ’ ἑκατόν
chosen_rendering: on side toward north one hundred by one hundred
alternate_renderings: cherubims spread out wings on high
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint court-dimension line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic cherubim verse.

greek_phrase: καὶ μενεῖ ἔξω τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας
chosen_rendering: remain outside his house seven days
alternate_renderings: shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days
rationale: Keeps Greek house wording rather than tent.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν Μανασση καὶ Εφραιμ
chosen_rendering: sons of Joseph by their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim
alternate_renderings: Shemida family and Hepher family
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint heading line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic clan entries.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Μαγηβως
chosen_rendering: sons of Magebos
alternate_renderings: children of Magbish
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in returnee register.

greek_phrase: ὑπάγετε εἰς τοὺς οἴκους ὑμῶν καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς κατασχέσεως ὑμῶν
chosen_rendering: turn back and go to your houses and to land of your possession
alternate_renderings: return and get you unto your tents and unto land of your possession
rationale: Keeps Greek houses wording rather than tents.

greek_phrase: ἐδόθη τοῖς υἱοῖς Μαχιρ ... τῷ ἡμίσει υἱῶν Μαχιρ
chosen_rendering: these were given to sons of Machir ... to half of sons of Machir
alternate_renderings: were pertaining unto children of Machir
rationale: Keeps the Greek gift wording explicit.

greek_phrase: ἀφελὼν ἀφέλοι αὐτά μετὰ τὴν ἡμέραν ἣν ἤκουσεν
chosen_rendering: if he removes them after day he heard
alternate_renderings: these are the statutes between man and wife etc.
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint delayed-cancellation rule at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic closing summary.

greek_phrase: ἡ αὐλὴ ἡ μεγάλη κυκλόθεν τρεῖς στιβάδες λίθων ἀπολελεκισμένων καὶ στιβὰς κέδρου
chosen_rendering: great court all around, three rows of hewn stones and a row of dressed cedar
alternate_renderings: candlesticks of pure gold five on right and five on left
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint court-construction line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic lampstand verse.

greek_phrase: οὕτως λέγει υἱὸς Αδερ
chosen_rendering: thus says son of Ader
alternate_renderings: Naboth said to Ahab Lord forbid it me
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Ben-hadad demand line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Naboth refusal.

greek_phrase: ἐν τῷ διορύγματι εὑρεθῇ ὁ κλέπτης
chosen_rendering: if thief is found in the breach
alternate_renderings: if man steal an ox or sheep and kill or sell it
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint burglary ruling at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic livestock-theft rule.

greek_phrase: ἐξανέστησαν ... εἰς ὄλεθρον καὶ ἐξαλεῖψαι
chosen_rendering: rose against inhabitants of mount Sēir to destroy and wipe out
alternate_renderings: stood up against inhabitants of mount Seir utterly to slay and destroy
rationale: Keeps the stronger Greek pair destroy and wipe out.

greek_phrase: υἱὸς Ελκανα υἱοῦ Εδαδ υἱοῦ Ελιηλ υἱοῦ Θιε
chosen_rendering: son of Elkana son of Edad son of Eliēl son of Thie
alternate_renderings: sons of Merari Mahli and Mushi
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint genealogy line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Merari heading.

greek_phrase: κατὰ πᾶσαν ἀδικίαν λεγομένην
chosen_rendering: in every matter of wrongdoing ... every alleged loss
alternate_renderings: if thief not found master of house shall be brought unto judges
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint comprehensive property-law summary at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic narrower case.

greek_phrase: ἐπὶ τοῦ ποδήρους κάτωθεν ἐποίησαν ῥοΐσκους
chosen_rendering: on hem of robe below they made pomegranates
alternate_renderings: he made bars of shittim wood
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint robe-hem line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic bar verse.

greek_phrase: Ἰακωβ ἐπάρας τοὺς πόδας ἐπορεύθη εἰς γῆν ἀνατολῶν πρὸς Λαβαν
chosen_rendering: Jacob lifting up his feet went to eastern land to Laban
alternate_renderings: Jacob went on his journey and came into land of people of east
rationale: Keeps the Greek fuller travel notice with Laban named here.

greek_phrase: ἔστη ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν τεθνηκότων καὶ τῶν ζώντων
chosen_rendering: he stood between dead and living and the breaking ceased
alternate_renderings: whosoever comes near tabernacle shall die
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint plague-stopping line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic complaint.

greek_phrase: ἐγὼ ... οὐκ ἦμεν ἐκδιδυσκόμενοι τὰ ἱμάτια ἡμῶν
chosen_rendering: we were not taking off our clothes
alternate_renderings: builders and burden-bearers worked with one hand and held weapon with other
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint vigilance line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic labor description.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Βεβι
chosen_rendering: sons of Bebi
alternate_renderings: children of Bebai
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in register.

greek_phrase: ὅτι ἐντολὴ τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπ’ αὐτούς
chosen_rendering: for command of the king was upon them
alternate_renderings: it was the king's commandment concerning them that a certain portion should be for singers
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint shorter royal-command note.

greek_phrase: Βερζελλι ὁ Γαλααδιτης κατέβη ἀπὸ Ρωγελλιμ καὶ διέβη μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως τὸν Ιορδάνην
chosen_rendering: Berzelli the Galaadite came down from Rhogellim and crossed with the king over the Jordan
alternate_renderings: Barzillai was a very aged man and had provided the king sustenance
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint travel scene at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic background notice.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐξέτριψαν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς καταβάσεως
chosen_rendering: crushed them on the descent
alternate_renderings: smote them in the going down
rationale: Keeps the Greek stronger verb crushed.

greek_phrase: Μεσωζεβελ Σαδδουκ Ιεδδουα
chosen_rendering: Mesōzebel Saddouk Ieddoua
alternate_renderings: Pelatiah Hanan Anaiah
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint signer names at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic list.

greek_phrase: τί ποιηθῇ σοι; εἰ ἔστιν λόγος σοι πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ἢ πρὸς τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς δυνάμεως
chosen_rendering: what needs to be done for you? Is there a word for you to king or commander of force
alternate_renderings: what should I do for thee? Hast thou any request to make to king or captain of host
rationale: Keeps the Greek word-for-you idiom close to the text.

greek_phrase: Αὕτη ἡ δόσις Ααρων καὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: this is gift of Aaron and of his sons
alternate_renderings: fire shall ever be burning upon altar
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint priestly gift line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic altar-fire line.

greek_phrase: ἐκέδασεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸ μέσον τῆς αὐλῆς
chosen_rendering: king consecrated middle of court
alternate_renderings: king hallowed middle of court
rationale: Keeps the Greek consecration verb with standard project rendering.

greek_phrase: συνήσεις ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα
chosen_rendering: you may understand to do all the things written
alternate_renderings: thou mayest observe to do all that is written
rationale: Keeps the Greek understanding-to-do phrasing.

greek_phrase: ἐποίησαν ἐπὶ τοῦ λογείου κροσσωτοὺς ἀρτύτους ἔργον πλεκτὸν χρυσίον καθαρόν
chosen_rendering: they made on the breastpiece braided cords woven chainwork of pure gold
alternate_renderings: one board had two connections
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint breastpiece-cord line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic tabernacle-board verse.

greek_phrase: ἰδοὺ ἐπὶ λόγων
chosen_rendering: behold upon records
alternate_renderings: behold they are written in book of kings of Israel
rationale: Keeps the Greek concise archival note.

greek_phrase: λιθοβολήσουσιν αὐτὸν λίθοις
chosen_rendering: they shall stone him with stones
alternate_renderings: all Israel shall hear and fear
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint execution verse at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic reaction verse.

greek_phrase: μὴ ἐξολεθρεύσῃς τὸ σπέρμα μου ὀπίσω μου
chosen_rendering: you will not destroy my seed after me
alternate_renderings: David swore unto Saul and Saul went home
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint oath request at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic closing note.

greek_phrase: οἱ θλίβοντες ἡμᾶς εἶπαν
chosen_rendering: those afflicting us said
alternate_renderings: cover not their iniquity
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint enemy-threat line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic imprecation.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ιωρα
chosen_rendering: sons of Iora
alternate_renderings: children of Jorah
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in returnee register.

greek_phrase: εἰς χεῖρας Σισαρα στρατηγοῦ δυνάμεως Ιαβιν βασιλέως Ασωρ
chosen_rendering: into hands of Sisara commander of army of Iabin king of Asōr
alternate_renderings: into hand of Sisera captain of host of Hazor
rationale: Keeps the Greek royal-name form Asōr.

greek_phrase: ἀνέστησεν κληρονόμησαι τὸν ἀμπελῶνα Ναβουθαι
chosen_rendering: rise inherit the vineyard of Nabouthai
alternate_renderings: then he numbered the young men of princes of provinces
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Jezebel speech at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic battle-count verse.

greek_phrase: καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ θύραι καὶ αἱ φάραγγες τετράγωνοι κατὰ τὰς θύρας
chosen_rendering: all the doors and the openings were squared with beam-work and from door to door threefold
alternate_renderings: four hundred pomegranates for the two networks
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint architectural line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic pomegranate count.

greek_phrase: αἱ βάσεις τῶν στύλων αὐτῶν χαλκαῖ ... καὶ πάντες οἱ στῦλοι τῆς αὐλῆς ἀργυρόχρυσοι
chosen_rendering: bases of their pillars were bronze and their hooks silver and their capitals silver-covered and all pillars of court were silver-covered
alternate_renderings: he made staves of shittim wood and overlaid them with gold to bear the table
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint court-pillar line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic table-staves verse.

greek_phrase: ἔθετο Δαυιδ τὰ ῥήματα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: David put the words in his heart
alternate_renderings: he changed behaviour before them and feigned madness
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint inner-response line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic behavior-change line.

greek_phrase: καὶ δέκα μόσχους ἐκλεκτοὺς καὶ εἴκοσι βόας νεμομένους καὶ ἑκατὸν πρόβατα
chosen_rendering: ten choice calves and twenty pasture-fed cattle and one hundred sheep
alternate_renderings: thou knowest how David my father could not build house
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint provisions line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic temple explanation.

greek_phrase: τοὺς δύο κλωστῆρας ἔθηκαν εἰς τὰς δύο ἀφέσεις
chosen_rendering: two woven cords they set into the two couplings
alternate_renderings: and for the other side of the tabernacle toward the north corner he made twenty boards
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint ephod-fastening line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic board count.

greek_phrase: ἄξονες ἐν τοῖς τροχοῖς ἐν τῇ μέχωνι
chosen_rendering: handles were in the wheels in the stand
alternate_renderings: he made the pillars and two rows round about upon the one network
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint basin-stand detail at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic pillar decoration verse.

greek_phrase: ἐπὶ κεφαλὰς τῶν στύλων ἔργον κρίνον κατὰ τὸ αιλὰμ τέσσαρες πήχεις
chosen_rendering: on heads of pillars was lily-work by the porch four cubits
alternate_renderings: house where he dwelt had another court within the porch
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint pillar-capital line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic palace-building verse.

greek_phrase: τοῖς υἱοῖς Μανασση κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν
chosen_rendering: as for sons of Manasseh by their families
alternate_renderings: of children of Joseph namely children of Ephraim
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Manasseh census line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Ephraim line.

greek_phrase: τῷ Γεδσων Λοβενι υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιεεθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ζεμμα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: to Gedson: Lobeni his son, Ieeeth his son, Zemma his son
alternate_renderings: Abishua begat Bukki and Bukki begat Uzzi
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint genealogy line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic priestly line.

greek_phrase: ἐὰν δέ τις ποιμάνῃ ἀγρὸν ἢ ἀμπελῶνα καὶ ἀποστείλῃ τὸ κτῆνος αὐτοῦ καταβοσκῆσαι ἀγρὸν ἕτερον
chosen_rendering: if someone lets a field or vineyard be grazed and lets his beast graze another field
alternate_renderings: if theft be found alive in his hand he shall restore double
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint grazing-damage law at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic theft case.

greek_phrase: οὐκ ᾔτησω πλοῦτον χρημάτων ἢ δόξαν οὐδὲ ψυχὴν τῶν ὑπεναντίων
chosen_rendering: you did not ask wealth riches or glory nor life of your adversaries
alternate_renderings: you have not asked riches wealth or honour nor life of your enemies
rationale: Keeps the Greek adversaries wording and fuller list.

greek_phrase: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἱερεύς Προσέλθωμεν ὧδε πρὸς τὸν θεόν
chosen_rendering: let us come near to God here
alternate_renderings: let us draw near here unto God
rationale: Keeps the Greek wording in straightforward English.

greek_phrase: ὅρκος τοῦ θεοῦ ἔσται ἀνὰ μέσον ἀμφοτέρων
chosen_rendering: an oath of God shall be between both of them
alternate_renderings: if a man deliver unto neighbour an ass or ox or sheep to keep and it die
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint oath ruling at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic deposit-case setup.

greek_phrase: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης
chosen_rendering: in the time of that very day
alternate_renderings: in the selfsame day
rationale: Keeps the Greek time phrase close to the text.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσεος φυλῆς Μανασση
chosen_rendering: and from half tribe of Manasse
alternate_renderings: of children of Issachar men that had understanding of times
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Manasseh troop line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Issachar note.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἔστησεν τοὺς στύλους τοῦ αιλαμ τοῦ ναοῦ
chosen_rendering: he set up pillars of porch of temple
alternate_renderings: then he made a porch for throne where he might judge
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint pillar-setting line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic judgment-porch verse.

greek_phrase: πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον τῶν ἁγίων τὸ εἰσφερόμενον εἰς οἶκον κυρίου
chosen_rendering: all the silver of the holy things brought into house of Lord
alternate_renderings: let priests take it to them and repair breaches of house
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint silver-collection line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic repair-order verse.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ηραμ
chosen_rendering: sons of Heram
alternate_renderings: children of Harim
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in register.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ηρεμ
chosen_rendering: sons of Herem
alternate_renderings: children of Harim
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in register.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐροῦσιν ὅτι Ἐγκατέλιπον τὴν διαθήκην κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν
chosen_rendering: and they will say because they abandoned covenant of Lord God of their fathers
alternate_renderings: all nations shall say wherefore has Lord done thus unto this land
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint explanatory answer at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic question.

greek_phrase: καὶ Δαυιδ ἦρεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶδεν ἄγγελον κυρίου ἑστῶτα ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
chosen_rendering: Dauid lifted his eyes and saw angel of Lord standing between earth and between heaven
alternate_renderings: David lifted up his eyes and saw angel of LORD stand between earth and heaven
rationale: Keeps the angel wording aligned with project rule.

greek_phrase: τὴν σκῦλαν αὐτῶν υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐπρονόμευσαν ἑαυτοῖς
chosen_rendering: all their spoil the sons of Israel plundered for themselves
alternate_renderings: all the spoil of these cities and cattle children of Israel took for prey
rationale: Keeps the Greek plunder wording and singular spoil collective.

greek_phrase: καὶ ὁ ῥάμνος εἶπεν τοῖς δένδρεσιν Ἐὰν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ ὑμεῖς χρίετέ με ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς βασιλέα
chosen_rendering: thorn bush said to trees if in truth you anoint me king over you
alternate_renderings: the bramble said to trees if ye in truth anoint me to reign over you
rationale: Keeps fresh project rendering thorn bush for rhamnos.

greek_phrase: Ιωας ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον κυρίου
chosen_rendering: Ioas did what was right before the Lord
alternate_renderings: but high places were not taken away
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint evaluation verse at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic high-place notice.

greek_phrase: τῷ Εσριηλ δῆμος ο Εσριηλι
chosen_rendering: of Esriel the clan of the Esrielite; of Sychem the clan of the Sychemite
alternate_renderings: these are sons of Ephraim after their families
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint clan line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Ephraim family list.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Κααθ Αμβραμ Ισσααρ Χεβρων καὶ Οζιηλ
chosen_rendering: sons of Kaath: Ambram, Issaar, Chebron, and Oziēl
alternate_renderings: children of Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Kohath line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Amram-Aaron line.

greek_phrase: καὶ νῦν πάντας τοὺς προφήτας τοῦ Βααλ πάντας τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἱερεῖς αὐτοῦ καλέσατε πρὸς με
chosen_rendering: and now call to me all prophets of Baal all his servants and all his priests
alternate_renderings: call unto me all prophets of Baal all his servants and all his priests
rationale: Keeps the Greek servant wording instead of switching to worshippers.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἔγραφεν αὐτοὺς Σαμαιας υἱὸς Ναθαναηλ ὁ γραμματεὺς ἐκ τοῦ Λευι
chosen_rendering: Samaias son of Nathanaēl scribe from Levi wrote them before king
alternate_renderings: Shemaiah son of Nethaneel the scribe one of the Levites wrote them before king
rationale: Keeps the Greek scribe-from-Levi phrase.

greek_phrase: ἐξήγαγέν σε κύριος ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ
chosen_rendering: Lord brought you out with mighty hand and high arm
alternate_renderings: Lord brought you out with mighty hand and redeemed you out of house of bondmen
rationale: Keeps the Greek high-arm phrase instead of smoothing it.

greek_phrase: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ ἑνὸς Ελδαδ καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ δευτέρου Μωδαδ
chosen_rendering: name of one Eldad and name of second Modad
alternate_renderings: name of one Eldad and name of other Medad
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form Modad.

greek_phrase: ζήσαμαι ἐκ τῆς ἀρρωστίας ταύτης
chosen_rendering: whether I will live from this sickness
alternate_renderings: whether I shall recover of this disease
rationale: Keeps the Greek live-from-sickness phrasing.

greek_phrase: καὶ αὗται αἱ χρεῖαι Σαλωμων ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ
chosen_rendering: these were the needs for Solomon in one day
alternate_renderings: Solomon sent to Hiram saying
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint provisions line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Hiram message.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἔλαβον ἃ ἐποίησεν Μιχα καὶ τὸν ἱερέα ὃς ἦν αὐτῷ
chosen_rendering: they took what Micha had made and the priest who was his
alternate_renderings: children of Dan took what Michaias had made and priest that he had
rationale: Keeps the Greek relative-clause wording.

greek_phrase: ἐποίησαν τὸ καταπέτασμα τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου
chosen_rendering: they made the curtain of the door of the tent of testimony
alternate_renderings: he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint curtain line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic ark-staves verse.

greek_phrase: τί ἀποκριθησόμεθα τῷ κυρίῳ ἢ τί λαλήσωμεν ἢ τί δικαιωθησόμεθα
chosen_rendering: what shall we answer to our lord or what shall we speak or how shall we be justified
alternate_renderings: what shall we say unto my lord or how shall we clear ourselves
rationale: Keeps the Greek justified wording.

greek_phrase: ἦρεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον ἑστηκότα ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: lifting his eyes he saw a man standing before him
alternate_renderings: he lifted up his eyes and looked and behold there stood a man opposite to him
rationale: Keeps the Greek before-him wording.

greek_phrase: τῇ συντριβῇ συντριβήσεσθε
chosen_rendering: with crushing you shall be crushed
alternate_renderings: you shall utterly be destroyed
rationale: Keeps the Greek doubled crushing idiom visible.

greek_phrase: και Μαγαρωθ και Βαιθαναμ και Θεκουμ, εξ πόλεις και αι κώμαι αυτών. Θεκω και Εφραθα, αύτη εστίν Βαιθλεεμ, και Φαγωρ και Αιταν και Κουλων και Ταταμ και Εωβης και Καρεμ και Γαλεμ και Θεθηρ και Μανοχω, ένδεκα πόλεις και αι κώμαι αυτών
lemma: Μαγαρωθ | Βαιθαναμ | Θεκουμ | Θεκω | Εφραθα | Βαιθλεεμ
chosen_rendering: and Magaroth and Baithanam and Thekoum ... Thekoa and Ephratha this is Bethlehem ... eleven cities and their villages
alternate_renderings: Maarath and Bethanoth and Eltekon six cities with their villages
rationale: Keeps the fuller Septuagint place list preserved at this numbering point.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἡγίασεν Ααρων καὶ τὰς στολὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς στολὰς τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετ’ αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: he sanctified Aaron and his garments and his sons and the garments of his sons with him
alternate_renderings: and he sanctified Aaron and his garments and his sons and his sons' garments with him
rationale: Keeps the Greek closing sanctification line in direct form.

greek_phrase: τοὺς τετρακοσίους ῥοίσκους ἀμφοτέροις τοῖς δικτύοις
chosen_rendering: four hundred pomegranates for both networks
alternate_renderings: work of the bases was on this manner they had borders between ledges
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint pomegranate-count line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic base-description verse.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν ἐκράτησεν Ραφαια ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Ιερουσαλημ
chosen_rendering: next to them Raphaia ruler of half district of Ierousalem repaired
alternate_renderings: next unto them repaired Rephaiah son of Hur ruler of half part of Jerusalem
rationale: Keeps the Greek district phrasing and concise repair notice.

greek_phrase: φυλάξεσθε τὰ προστάγματά μου τοῦ μὴ ποιεῖν ἀπὸ τῶν νομίμων τῶν βδελυρῶν
chosen_rendering: you shall keep my commands so as not to do any of the abominable statutes
alternate_renderings: keep mine ordinance that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs
rationale: Keeps the Greek command/statute wording.

greek_phrase: οὗτοι δῆμοι Μανασση κατὰ τὴν ἐπίσκεψιν αὐτῶν δύο καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι
chosen_rendering: these are the clans of Manasseh by their enrollment fifty-two thousand seven hundred
alternate_renderings: sons of Benjamin after their families
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Manasseh total at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Benjamin list.

greek_phrase: τρίχος στίχος· λιγύριον καὶ ἀχάτης καὶ ἀμέθυστος
chosen_rendering: third row ligure and agate and amethyst
alternate_renderings: covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red and badgers' skins above that
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint gemstone-row line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic tent-covering verse.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Αδιν
chosen_rendering: sons of Adin
alternate_renderings: children of Adin
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in register.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Βανουι
chosen_rendering: sons of Banoui
alternate_renderings: children of Bani
rationale: Keeps Greek proper-name form in register.

greek_phrase: υἱὸς ηὐξημένος Ιωσηφ, υἱὸς ηὐξημένος καὶ ζηλωτὸς, υἱός μου νεώτατος
chosen_rendering: Joseph is a son increased my increased and envied son my youngest son
alternate_renderings: Joseph is a fruitful bough
rationale: Keeps the difficult Greek poetic wording rather than harmonizing it to the Masoretic vine image.

greek_phrase: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ηλιου τὸν Θεσβίτην λέγων
chosen_rendering: Lord said to Elijah the Thesbite saying
alternate_renderings: young men of princes of provinces went out first
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Elijah line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic battle movement verse.

greek_phrase: Ἀρθήσεται κύριός σου ἀπάνωθεν τῆς κεφαλῆς σου
chosen_rendering: your lord is taking away from over your head
alternate_renderings: thy master is about to take away from thy head
rationale: Keeps the Greek over-your-head phrase.

greek_phrase: καὶ προσήγαγον αὐτὸν ἔναντι κυρίου ... καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἔσφαξεν τὴν θυσίαν ... καὶ προσήγαγεν τὸ παιδάριον καὶ ἔσφαξεν τὸν μόσχον
chosen_rendering: they brought him before the Lord and his father slaughtered the sacrifice ... and he brought the child and slaughtered the calf
alternate_renderings: they slew a bullock and brought the child to Eli
rationale: Keeps the fuller Septuagint scene at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic summary.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις ἡμεῖς διατιθέμεθα πίστιν καὶ γράφομεν
chosen_rendering: we are making a faithful covenant and writing it
alternate_renderings: now those that sealed were Nehemiah etc.
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint covenant-writing line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic signer list heading.

greek_phrase: καὶ σχίσας ξύλα εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν
chosen_rendering: splitting wood for a whole-burnt offering
alternate_renderings: clave the wood for the burnt offering
rationale: Keeps the Greek whole-burnt-offering term.

greek_phrase: βέλος σωτηρίας τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ βέλος σωτηρίας ἐν Συρίᾳ
chosen_rendering: an arrow of salvation for the Lord and an arrow of salvation against Syria
alternate_renderings: the arrow of the LORD's deliverance and the arrow of deliverance from Syria
rationale: Keeps the Greek salvation phrasing without importing deliverance idiom.

greek_phrase: τὸ ἐκπορευόμενον διὰ τῶν χειλέων σου φυλάξῃ καὶ ποιήσεις
chosen_rendering: what goes out through your lips you shall keep and do
alternate_renderings: when thou comest into thy neighbour's vineyard then thou mayest eat grapes
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint vow-speech line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic vineyard law.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὴν θάλασσαν δέκα ἐν πηχύσιν ἀπὸ τοῦ χείλους αὐτῆς ἕως τοῦ χείλους αὐτῆς ... καὶ τριάκοντα τρεῖς πήχεις ἐκύκλου αὐτήν
chosen_rendering: he made the Sea ten cubits from rim to rim ... and thirty-three cubits in a gathering encircled it
alternate_renderings: the foundation was of costly stones
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Sea-dimensions line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic foundation verse.

greek_phrase: καὶ Μανασσης ἐξέχεεν αἷμα ἀθῷον σφόδρα ἕως οὗ ἐπλήσθη Ιερουσαλημ στόμα εἰς στόμα
chosen_rendering: Manassēs poured out very much innocent blood until he filled Jerusalem from mouth to mouth
alternate_renderings: till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another
rationale: Keeps the vivid Greek from-mouth-to-mouth phrase.

greek_phrase: πᾶν διανοῖγον μήτραν ἀπὸ πάσης σαρκὸς
chosen_rendering: every opener of the womb from all flesh
alternate_renderings: every thing that opens the womb in all flesh
rationale: Keeps the Greek opener wording in direct form.

greek_phrase: καὶ διεμαρτυράμην ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πωλήσεως αὐτῶν
chosen_rendering: I testified on day of their selling
alternate_renderings: I testified against them in day wherein they sold victuals
rationale: Keeps the Greek concise testimony phrase.

greek_phrase: Ελιαβ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιδαερ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ελκανα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: Eliab his son Idaer his son Elkana his son
alternate_renderings: Ahitub begat Zadok and Zadok begat Shallum
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint genealogy line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic priestly line.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Φαραω Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ εἶπεν
chosen_rendering: Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said
alternate_renderings: the frogs shall come up both on thee and upon thy people
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint plea-to-pray line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic plague announcement.

greek_phrase: καὶ τῆς γυναικὸς τῆς ῥεούσης ἐν τῷ χωρισμῷ αὐτῆς καὶ τοῦ γονορρυοῦς ἐν τῇ ῥύσει αὐτοῦ τῷ ἄρσενι καὶ τῇ θηλείᾳ
chosen_rendering: of the woman flowing in her separation and of the one with discharge in his flow for the male and for the female
alternate_renderings: of her that is sick of her flowers and of him that has an issue
rationale: Keeps the Greek clause structure and terminology close.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Ελαμαρ
chosen_rendering: sons of Elam-ar
alternate_renderings: children of the other Elam
rationale: Keeps the Greek proper-name form.

greek_phrase: καὶ εἶπεν Αὔριον ... Ὡς εἴρηκας
chosen_rendering: he said Tomorrow ... As you have spoken
alternate_renderings: Aaron stretched out his hand over waters of Egypt and frogs came up
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint dialogue line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic plague-action verse.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ισσαχαρ εἰδότων σύνεσιν εἰς τοὺς καιρούς τοῦ γινώσκειν τί ποιήσει Ισραηλ
chosen_rendering: and from sons of Issachar knowing understanding for times knowing what Israel should do
alternate_renderings: of Zebulun such as went forth to battle
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Issachar line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Zebulun line.

greek_phrase: οὐ βδελύξῃ Ιδουμαῖον ὅτι ἀδελφός σου ἐστίν· οὐ βδελύξῃ Αἰγύπτιον ὅτι πάροικος ἐγενήθης ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: you shall not abhor an Idumean because he is your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian because you became a resident in his land
alternate_renderings: the children begotten of them shall enter congregation of LORD in third generation
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint prohibition line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic third-generation rule.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέψαι τὸν ἐνιαυτὸν υἱὸς Αδερ ἐπεσκέψατο τὴν Συρίαν καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Αφεκα πολεμῆσαι ἐπὶ Ισραηλ
chosen_rendering: it came to be at the turn of the year son of Ader reviewed Syria and went up to Apheka to war against Israel
alternate_renderings: he did very abominably in following idols
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint war-preparation line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic idolatry verdict.

greek_phrase: καὶ Ιησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυη εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς
chosen_rendering: Joshua son of Nun went in to the priests
alternate_renderings: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said unto them
rationale: Keeps the Greek went-in wording.

greek_phrase: καθὰ τὰ ἔτη πολλά πληθυνεῖς τὴν κτῆσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ καθὰ τὰ ἔτη ὀλίγα ἐλαττώσεις τὴν κτῆσιν αὐτοῦ
chosen_rendering: according as years are many you shall increase its purchase and according as years are few you shall lessen its purchase
alternate_renderings: according to multitude of years thou shalt increase price thereof
rationale: Keeps the Greek purchase phrasing rather than switching to price.

greek_phrase: οἱ δὲ Γαβαωνῖται οὐκ εἰσὶν ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰσραηλ ἀλλ’ ἢ ἀπὸ τοῦ λείμματος τοῦ Ἀμορραίου
chosen_rendering: Gabaonites are not from sons of Israel but from remnant of the Amorrite
alternate_renderings: now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel but of the remnant of the Amorites
rationale: Keeps Greek name form Amorrite and direct origin clause.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ εἷς τῶν παίδων Σαουλ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ συνεχόμενος ἐνώπιον κυρίου ... Δωηκ ὁ Σύρος ποιμαίνων τὰς ἡμιόνους Σαουλ
chosen_rendering: there was there one of servants of Saoul on that day held in before the Lord ... Dōēk the Syrian pasturing the mules of Saoul
alternate_renderings: David said unto Ahimelech is there not here under thy hand spear or sword
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Doeg notice at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic weapons request.

greek_phrase: Χαλεβ πατὴρ Ασχα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαχιρ· οὗτος πατὴρ Ασσαθων
chosen_rendering: Chaleb father of Ascha begot Machir; this one was father of Assathon
alternate_renderings: Chelub brother of Shuah begot Mehir father of Eshton
rationale: Keeps the Greek name forms and structure.

greek_phrase: ἤρξαντο ἐν μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου ἁγιάζειν
lemma: καὶ τῇ ὀγδόῃ τοῦ μηνὸς εἰσῆλθαν εἰς τὸν ναὸν κυρίου ... καὶ τῇ ἑκκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου συνετέλεσαν
chosen_rendering: they began on first day of new moon of first month to sanctify ... on sixteenth day of first month they finished
alternate_renderings: they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify ... in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end
rationale: Keeps the Greek new-moon phrasing and the sixteenth-day reading.

greek_phrase: καὶ Εφραιμ οὐκ ἐξώλεθρευσεν τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Γαζερ ... ἕως οὗ Φαραω βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου ἀνέβη καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐνέπρησεν αὐτὴν ἐν πυρί
chosen_rendering: Ephraim did not destroy the Canaanite dwelling in Gazer ... until Pharaoh king of Egypt went up and took it and burned it with fire
alternate_renderings: they drove not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer and they served under tribute
rationale: Keeps the longer Septuagint expansion about Pharaoh.

greek_phrase: καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ποιοῦντες τὸ ἔργον τοῦ οἴκου· Αμασι υἱὸς Ζαχαρια ... Φασσουρ ... Μελχια
chosen_rendering: and their brothers doing work of the house: Amasi son of Zacharia ... Phassour ... Melchia
alternate_renderings: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah son of Jeroham...
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint genealogy and omits the Masoretic total at this numbering point.

greek_phrase: περὶ τετρακοσίους ἄνδρες ἀνέβησαν ὀπίσω Δαυιδ καὶ διακόσιοι ἐκάθισαν μετὰ τῶν σκευῶν
chosen_rendering: about four hundred men went up after David and two hundred sat with the baggage
alternate_renderings: David and his men girded on swords and two hundred abode by the stuff
rationale: Keeps the Greek simpler action line.

greek_phrase: πᾶς ἄρσην ἐν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν φάγεται αὐτήν ... πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος αὐτῶν ἁγιασθήσεται
chosen_rendering: every male among the priests shall eat it ... everyone who touches them shall be sanctified
alternate_renderings: he shall put off his garments and carry forth the ashes
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint priestly-eating line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic ash-removal rule.

greek_phrase: ποιήσω ἔλεος μετὰ Ανων υἱοῦ Ναας ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἔλεος
chosen_rendering: I will do mercy with Anōn son of Naas in the way his father did mercy with me
alternate_renderings: I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash as his father showed kindness unto me
rationale: Keeps the Greek mercy wording instead of changing to kindness.

greek_phrase: ἰδοὺ οἱ προφῆται ἐλάλησαν ἐν στόματι ἑνὶ ἀγαθὰ περὶ τοῦ βασιλέως
chosen_rendering: behold prophets spoke with one mouth good things about king
alternate_renderings: the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent
rationale: Keeps the Greek one-mouth idiom.

greek_phrase: Αριφ Αναθωθ Νωβαι
chosen_rendering: Ariph Anathoth Nōbai
alternate_renderings: Magpiash Meshullam Hezir
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint signer names at this numbering point.

greek_phrase: τὸ αιλαμ τῶν στύλων πεντήκοντα πήχεων μῆκος καὶ τριάκοντα ἐν πλάτει τετραγωνισμένον
chosen_rendering: Porch of the Pillars was fifty cubits in length and thirty in breadth fitted in balance
alternate_renderings: the ten bases and ten lavers on the bases
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint porch-description line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic basin list.

greek_phrase: ἔθετο κύριος τὸν Ιορδάνην ὅριον ἀνὰ μέσον ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὑμῖν μερὶς κυρίου
chosen_rendering: Lord set the Jordan as a boundary between us and you and you have no share of the Lord
alternate_renderings: LORD has made Jordan a border between us and you ye have no part in the LORD
rationale: Keeps the Greek share language and direct statement.

greek_phrase: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν ἱκανόν· μὴ καυχάσθω ὁ κυρτὸς ὡς ὁ εὐθής
chosen_rendering: king of Israel answered and said let it be enough; let not the bent one boast like the upright one
alternate_renderings: the men of his city did as Jezebel had sent unto them
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint proverb line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic Jezebel action verse.

greek_phrase: υἱοὶ Σαμουηλ ὁ πρωτότοκος Σανι καὶ Αβια
chosen_rendering: sons of Samuel: the firstborn Sani and Abia
alternate_renderings: Shallum begat Hilkiah and Hilkiah begat Azariah
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint Samuel line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic priestly genealogy.

greek_phrase: καὶ τέσσαρες τροχοὶ χαλκοῖ τῇ μέχωνι τῇ μιᾷ
chosen_rendering: four bronze wheels belonged to each stand
alternate_renderings: and nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint basin-stand line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic capital-networks verse.

greek_phrase: Σαλωμων ἐπληθύνθη σφόδρα ὑπὲρ τὴν σοφίαν πάντων ἀρχαίων ἀνθρώπων καὶ ὑπὲρ πάντας φρονίμους Αἰγύπτου
chosen_rendering: Solomon was greatly multiplied in understanding beyond understanding of all ancient men and all wise of Egypt
alternate_renderings: Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint wisdom line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic timber-supply verse.

greek_phrase: καὶ πᾶς σοφὸς ἐν τοῖς ἐργαζομένοις ἐποίησεν τὰς στολὰς τῶν ἁγίων αἳ εἰσὶν Ααρων τῷ ἱερεῖ
chosen_rendering: every wise one among those working made the holy garments that belong to Aaron the priest
alternate_renderings: every wise hearted man among them wrought work of the tabernacle made ten curtains
rationale: Keeps the Septuagint holy-garments line at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic curtain-making verse.

greek_phrase: Δαυιδ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ... καὶ ἦσαν συγκλειόμεναι ἕως ἡμέρας θανάτου αὐτῶν χῆραι ζῶσαι
chosen_rendering: David entered his house at Ierousalem ... and they were shut away until the day of their death living as widows
alternate_renderings: David came to his house at Jerusalem and put them in ward
rationale: Keeps the fuller Greek custody line.

greek_phrase: ἤνεγκαν ἑπτὰ μόσχους ἑπτὰ κριοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀμνοὺς ἑπτὰ χιμάρους αἰγῶν περὶ ἁμαρτίας περὶ τῆς βασιλείας καὶ περὶ τῶν ἁγίων καὶ περὶ Ισραηλ
chosen_rendering: they brought seven calves seven rams seven lambs seven male goats of goats for sin for kingdom and for holy things and for Israel
alternate_renderings: they brought seven bullocks seven rams seven lambs and seven he goats for a sin offering for the kingdom and for Judah
rationale: Keeps the Greek wording holy things and Israel.

chosen_rendering: And in Seir the Chorraean dwelt formerly, and the sons of Esau destroyed them and crushed them from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did to the land of his inheritance which the Lord gave them.
alternate_renderings: The Horims also dwelt in Seir in time past; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their position; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the boundary shall pass from there to Luz, on the south of Luz, from the south, this is Bethel, and the boundary shall go down to Maatarothorech, to the hill-country that is south of lower Bethhoron.
alternate_renderings: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lies on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Besides genealogy of males from three years and upward, to everyone entering house of Lord for matter of days day by day, for service in courses of their ordinance.
alternate_renderings: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that enters into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he spoke concerning trees, from the cedar in Lebanon even to the hyssop that comes out through the wall, and he spoke concerning cattle and concerning birds and concerning creeping things and concerning fish.
alternate_renderings: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it happened, when the congregation rushed together against Moses and Aaron, they rushed toward the tent of testimony, and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
alternate_renderings: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he made the utensils of the table, both the dishes and the censers and the cups and the bowls in which he would pour offerings, of gold.
alternate_renderings: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: As the Lord commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel made all the equipment.
alternate_renderings: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And from Zebulun, going out for battle line with every weapon of war, fifty thousand to help David, not double-hearted.
alternate_renderings: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Solomon did evil before the Lord. He did not walk after the Lord as David his father did.
alternate_renderings: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The sons of Zebulun by their clans: of Sared, the clan of the Saredite; of Allon, the clan of the Allonite; of Allel, the clan of the Allelite.
alternate_renderings: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Ahab's spirit became troubled, and he lay upon his bed and covered his face and did not eat bread.
alternate_renderings: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to your saying, I am yours, and all that I have.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the sons of Israel committed a great trespass and stole from the devoted thing, and Achar son of Carmi son of Zimri son of Zerah from the tribe of Judah took from the devoted thing, and the wrath of the Lord was angered against the sons of Israel.
alternate_renderings: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.
