rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he placed them on the shoulders of the ephod, as memorial stones of the sons of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.
alternate_renderings: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the gatekeepers cried out and reported it inside the house of the king.
alternate_renderings: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: a gold bell and a pomegranate on the hem of the robe all around, for ministering, as the Lord commanded Moses.
alternate_renderings: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Command the sons of Israel and say to them, You are entering into the land of Canaan. This shall be for you as an inheritance, the land of Canaan with its borders.
alternate_renderings: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When all of you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Moses said to Pharaoh, Set for me when I should pray concerning you and concerning your servants and concerning your people, to wipe out the frogs from you and from your people and from your houses; only in the river will they be left.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth yours hand with your rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Sons of Nebo: 52.
alternate_renderings: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it was reported to Joab, saying, Behold, the king is weeping and mourning over Absalom.
alternate_renderings: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Sadok, young man mighty in strength, and from his father’s house, twenty-two chiefs.
alternate_renderings: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for until now the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: for Zebulun, Shemaiah son of Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jerimoth son of Azriel;
alternate_renderings: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And I contended with them and cursed them and struck men among them and made them bald, and made them swear by God that you will not give your daughters to their sons and will not take from their daughters for your sons.
alternate_renderings: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and stroke certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, All of you shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if a man eats holy things by ignorance, he shall add a fifth part to it and give the holy thing to the priest.
alternate_renderings: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: You shall mistreat no widow or orphan.
alternate_renderings: You shall neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for all of you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to be, when David finished speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, Is this your voice, child David? And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.
alternate_renderings: And he said to David, You are more righteous than I: for you have rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded you evil.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: His gift was one silver dish, its weight one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels by the holy shekel, both full of fine flour prepared with oil for sacrifice,
alternate_renderings: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a food offering:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: His gift was one silver dish, its weight one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels by the holy shekel, both full of fine flour prepared with oil for sacrifice,
alternate_renderings: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a food offering:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And on twenty-third of seventh month he sent people to their tents rejoicing and with good heart over good things which Lord did to David and to Solomon and to Israel his people.
alternate_renderings: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had showed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And its five posts and rings, and they overlaid their capitals and clasps with gold, and their five bases were bronze.
alternate_renderings: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: If someone gives his neighbor silver or goods to keep, and it is stolen from the man's house, if the thief is found, he shall repay double.
alternate_renderings: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Mephibosheth said to him, My lord king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said to him, Saddle the donkey for me, and I will mount it and go with the king, because your servant is lame.
alternate_renderings: And he has slandered your servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in yours eyes.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to be that night that the Lord said to him, Take your father's fatted calf, the seven-year-old bull, and pull down the altar of Baal that belongs to your father, and cut down the grove upon it.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take your father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the grove that is by it:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Elisha said, Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord: At this time tomorrow a measure of fine flour will be a shekel, and two measures of barley a shekel, at the gates of Samaria.
alternate_renderings: Then Elisha said, Hear all of you the word of the LORD; Thus says the LORD, Tomorrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and Dabor and its surrounding lands, and Anam and its surrounding lands,
alternate_renderings: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Saul feared from before David.
alternate_renderings: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to be after these things that David’s heart struck him because he had removed the wing of his double cloak.
alternate_renderings: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD's anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And fire shall burn continually on the altar; it shall not be extinguished.
alternate_renderings: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with your estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: the blessings of your father and mother prevailed above the blessings of abiding mountains and the blessings of everlasting hills. They will be on Joseph's head and on the crown of the one who led his brothers.
alternate_renderings: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my conceivers unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Pharaoh Nechao made Eliakim son of Josiah king of Judah in place of Josiah his father and changed his name to Jehoiakim, and Pharaoh Nechao took Jehoahaz his brother and brought him into Egypt, and he died there. And they gave silver and gold to Pharaoh. Then land began to be taxed, to give silver according to mouth of Pharaoh, and each man required silver and gold from people of land according to ability, to give to Pharaoh Nechao.
alternate_renderings: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: so that he may establish you for himself as a people and he himself will be your God, in the way he said to you and in the way he swore to your fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob.
alternate_renderings: That you should enter into covenant with the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God makes with you this day:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Saul said to David, You are more righteous than I, because you repaid me good things, but I repaid you evil things.
alternate_renderings: And you have showed this day how that you have dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into yours hand, you killed me not.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they were ministering before the tent of the house of testimony with instruments until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they stood according to their judgment over their services.
alternate_renderings: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Hattush, Sebani, Malluch,
alternate_renderings: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: All these were sons of Asher, all chiefs of fathers, chosen mighty men of power, leading chiefs. Their number for drawing up battle was twenty-six thousand men.
alternate_renderings: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were able to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: He made all the utensils of the altar and its fire-pan and the base and the bowls and the bronze flesh-hooks.
alternate_renderings: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and the bronze frame of the altar and all the utensils of the altar and all the instruments of the tent of testimony.
alternate_renderings: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Aaron the priest went up by command of the Lord and died there, in the fortieth year of the departure of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
alternate_renderings: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the rest of the words of Joash and all that he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
alternate_renderings: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goes down to Silla.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And their libation shall be half a hin for the one bull and a third of a hin for the one ram and a fourth of a hin of wine for the one lamb. This is the whole burnt offering of month by month throughout the months of the year.
alternate_renderings: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And next to them Meremoth son of Urijah son of Koz repaired, and next to them Meshullam son of Berechiah son of Meshezabeel repaired, and next to them Sadok son of Baana repaired.
alternate_renderings: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the seven cows ugly in appearance and thin in flesh devoured the seven cows beautiful in appearance and choice in flesh. And Pharaoh woke up.
alternate_renderings: And the ill favoured and thin cattle did eat up the seven well favoured and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: These are the sons of Benjamin by their clans, by their enrollment, forty-five thousand six hundred.
alternate_renderings: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: For this alone is his covering; this is the garment of his nakedness. In what shall he sleep? So if he cries out to me, I will hear him, for I am merciful.
alternate_renderings: If you at all take your neighbour's raiment to pledge, you shall deliver it unto him by that the sun goes down:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Against him, taking evil counsel, they reviled him, and lords of arrows pressed hard upon him.
alternate_renderings: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And sons were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt, whom Asenath daughter of Petephres priest of Heliopolis bore to him, Manasseh and Ephraim. And there were sons of Manasseh, whom the Syrian concubine bore to him, Machir. And Machir begot Gilead. And the sons of Ephraim, brother of Manasseh, were Sutalaam and Taam. And the sons of Sutalaam were Eden.
alternate_renderings: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord said to Moses, Stretch out your hand to the sky, and there will be hail on all the land of Egypt, both on the human beings and on the livestock and on every plant on the land.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth yours hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Moses saw all the works, and they had done them just as the Lord commanded Moses. So they made them, and Moses blessed them.
alternate_renderings: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an armour of jacket, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: You all stand today before the Lord your God, your tribal leaders and your elders and your judges and your scribes, every man of Israel,
alternate_renderings: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that all of you may prosper in all that all of you do.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: We shall pass through your land. We shall go by the road. We shall not turn aside into field or vineyard. We shall not drink water from your well. We shall go by the king's road until we pass your borders.
alternate_renderings: Let me pass through your land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past your borders.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And after this came the continual whole burnt offerings, and those for the new moons, and for all the sanctified feasts, and for everyone freely offering a freewill gift to the Lord.
alternate_renderings: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And for the sons of Gershon, from the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naphtali and from the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
alternate_renderings: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Sons of Merari: Mahali, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
alternate_renderings: And Azariah brings forth Seraiah, and Seraiah brings forth Jehozadak,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The refuge shall be for the sons of Israel and for the proselyte and for the resident among you. These cities shall be a refuge, for everyone striking a soul unintentionally to flee there.
alternate_renderings: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that kills any person unexpectedly may flee thither.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they prophesied until the evening passed, and it came to be at the time for the sacrifice to go up, and there was no voice. alternate_renderings: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And their brothers according to houses of their fathers, the Levites, were given for every work of service of the tent of the house of God.
alternate_renderings: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the sons of Benjamin went out to meet the people and were drawn away from the city and began to strike from the people as once and again on the roads, one going up to Bethel and one going up to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men in Israel.
alternate_renderings: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The rings shall be under the rim, as holders for the carrying-poles, so that the table may be carried by them.
alternate_renderings: Opposite to the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: You shall not greet them with peace, nor seek what benefits them, all your days forever.
alternate_renderings: You shall not detest an Edomite; for he is your brother: you shall not detest an Egyptian; because you were a stranger in his land.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And because if anyone should find his enemy in affliction and send him away on a good road, then the Lord will repay him good things, as you have done today.
alternate_renderings: And now, behold, I know well that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in yours hand.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: their camels 435, their donkeys 6,720.
alternate_renderings: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: But if the owner is with it, he shall not repay. But if it is hired, it shall stand for its hire.
alternate_renderings: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Moses said to them, If the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad cross the Jordan with you, every armed man for war before the Lord, and you subdue the land before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
alternate_renderings: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then all of you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The sons of Asher by their clans: of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminites; of Jesui, the clan of the Jesuite; of Beri, the clan of the Bariite.
alternate_renderings: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Of Jashub, the clan of the Jashubite; of Samaran, the clan of the Samaranite.
alternate_renderings: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Elkana his son, Souphi his son, and Naath his son,
alternate_renderings: And Azariah brings forth Amariah, and Amariah brings forth Ahitub,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Whoever steals one of the sons of Israel, and after overpowering him sells him, and he is found in his hand, let him certainly be put to death.
alternate_renderings: And he that curses his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Jeroboam turned ambush to come upon them from behind, and battle was before Judah and ambush behind them.
alternate_renderings: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The dead one of Ahab in the city, dogs will eat, and the dead one of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.
alternate_renderings: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And now, behold, I know that in reigning you will reign, and the kingdom of Israel will stand in your hands.
alternate_renderings: Swear now therefore unto me by the LORD, that you will not cut off my seed after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father's house.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the victory on that day became mourning for all the people, because the people heard on that day, saying, The king grieves over his son.
alternate_renderings: And the people got them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you will not listen according to their judgment, which they do.
alternate_renderings: Nevertheless they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

chosen_rendering: From sons of Simeon, mighty in strength for battle line, seven thousand one hundred.

chosen_rendering: Cursed are your storehouses and your reserves.
