rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the king said to Doeg, Turn yourself and attack the priests. And Doeg the Syrian turned and killed the priests of the Lord on that day, three hundred and five men, all carrying ephod.
alternate_renderings: And the king said to Doeg, Turn you, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Abram, hearing that Lot his nephew had been taken captive, numbered his own home-born ones, three hundred eighteen, and pursued after them as far as Dan.
alternate_renderings: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And my heart counseled within me, and I contended with the nobles and the rulers and said to them, Each man demands from his brother? You are demanding. And I set against them a great assembly.
alternate_renderings: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, All of you exact interest, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall weave into it a setting of four rows of stones. The first row: sardius, topaz, emerald.
alternate_renderings: And you shall set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a ruby, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord, the one going together with you, will not leave you nor forsake you. Do not fear, nor be cowardly.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD, he it is that does go before you; he will be with you, he will not fail you, neither forsake you: fear not, neither be dismayed.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Every animal that divides the hoof and splits the hoof in two and chews the cud among the animals, these you shall eat.
alternate_renderings: Whatsoever parts the hoof, and is cloven footed, and chews the cud, among the beasts, that shall all of you eat.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Jokshan begot Teman and Sheba and Dedan. And sons of Dedan became Reuel and Adbeel and Assourieim and Latousieim and Laomeim.
alternate_renderings: And Jokshan brings forth Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if a woman lies with a man in an emission of seed, they shall bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
alternate_renderings: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: their sacrifice being fine flour kneaded in oil, three tenths for the one bull and two tenths for the one ram,
alternate_renderings: And their food offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And cattle in great multitude belonged to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad, very many, and they saw the land of Jaazer and the land of Gilead, and the place was a place for cattle.
alternate_renderings: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And to Reuben and to Gad I gave from Gilead as far as the torrent Arnon, the middle of the torrent as a border, and as far as Jabbok, the torrent being the border of the sons of Ammon.
alternate_renderings: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the man went from the city of Judah, from Bethlehem, to reside wherever he might find, and he came to the hill-country of Ephraim, as far as the house of Micah, to make his way.
alternate_renderings: And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you will strike every fortified city, and you will bring down every good tree, and you will stop up all springs of water, and every good tract you will spoil with stones.
alternate_renderings: And all of you shall strike every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and ruin every good piece of land with stones.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Minaeans gave gifts to Uzziah, and his name was until entrance of Egypt, because he grew strong exceedingly.
alternate_renderings: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he put garrisons in valley, and all Edomites became servants of David, and Lord kept saving David in all places he went.
alternate_renderings: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David anywhere he went.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And will you turn away today from the Lord? And it shall be, if you revolt today from the Lord, then tomorrow wrath will be on all Israel.
alternate_renderings: But that all of you must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, seeing all of you rebel to day against the LORD, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the men going up with him said, We will not go up, because we will not be able to go up against the nation, because it is stronger than we are.
alternate_renderings: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Assathon begot Bathrephan and Phessee and Thana father of city Nahash, brother of Eselon the Kenezite. These are men of Repha.
alternate_renderings: And Eshton brings forth Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And in that he broke with king Nebuchadnezzar what he had sworn him by God, he hardened his neck and strengthened his heart, so as not to turn back to Lord God of Israel.
alternate_renderings: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And rest of matters of Jotham and war and deeds of him, behold, written in book of kings of Judah and Israel.
alternate_renderings: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to be, as he rose up, Ehud stretched out his left hand and took the sword from his right thigh and drove it into the belly of Eglon.
alternate_renderings: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, Where are the men whom you killed at Tabor? And they said, As you are, so were they, like the appearance, the form, of sons of kings.
alternate_renderings: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom all of you slew at Tabor? And they answered, As you are, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Ehud made for himself a double-edged sword a span in length and girded it under his cloak on his right thigh.
alternate_renderings: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and Bethmarcaboth and Hemi-soseim and house of Baroumseorim. These were their cities until king David.
alternate_renderings: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, Let us constrain you now, and we will prepare before you a kid of the goats.
alternate_renderings: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray you, let us detain you, until we shall have made ready a kid for you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day and gave them law and judgment in Shiloh before the tent of the God of Israel.
alternate_renderings: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord amazed them from before the sons of Israel and crushed them with a great crushing in Gibeon, and they pursued them on the road of the ascent of Beth-horon and were cutting them down as far as Azekah and as far as Makkedah.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD humiliated them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goes up to Bethhoron, and stroke them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Joshua son of Nun sent from Shittim two young men to spy, saying, Go up and see the land and Jericho. And going, the two young men entered into Jericho and entered into the house of a prostitute woman whose name was Rahab, and they lodged there.
alternate_renderings: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Achsah said to him, Give me a blessing, because you gave me into a south land, and you shall give me a redemption of water. And Caleb gave her according to her heart, the redemption of the heights and the redemption of the low places.
alternate_renderings: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for you have given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he took them and crossed the torrent and brought over all that was his.
alternate_renderings: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you answered me and said, Good is the word that you spoke to do.
alternate_renderings: And all of you answered me, and said, The thing which you have spoken is good for us to do.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Now stay away from there, governors beyond the River, Shetharboznai and your fellow-servants, the Apharsachaeans beyond the River.
alternate_renderings: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be all of you far from thence:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Cursed are you in your going out, and cursed are you in your coming in.
alternate_renderings: Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the fat for the things concerning sins he shall offer on the altar.
alternate_renderings: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And all vessels of house of God, great and small, and treasures and all treasures of king and nobles, he brought all into Babylon.
alternate_renderings: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord sent you on a road and said to you, Go, and utterly destroy Amalek, the ones sinning against me, and you will fight them until you finish them.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD sent you on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the word pleased Pharaoh and all his servants.
alternate_renderings: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the young man knew nothing, except that Jonathan and David knew the word.
alternate_renderings: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean what is behind you. It shall be for the proselyte and the orphan and the widow.
alternate_renderings: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you shall not glean it afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he said, I will turn my face away from them and show what will be for them at the end, because it is a generation turned aside, sons in whom there is no faithfulness.
alternate_renderings: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faith.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the donkey, seeing the angel of God, pressed herself against the wall and crushed Balaam's foot, and he continued to whip her.
alternate_renderings: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he stroke her again.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the king of the Assyrians listened to him, and the king of the Assyrians went up to Damascus and captured it and deported it, and Rezin he killed.
alternate_renderings: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: whose sacrifice fat you were eating and drinking the wine of their libations? Let them rise and help you and become your shelters.
alternate_renderings: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it happened in that day Isaac's servants came and reported to him about the well that they dug, and they said, We did not find water.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said unto him, We have found water.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it happened, when king heard words of law, he tore his garments.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And King Joram went out on that day from Samaria and reviewed Israel.
alternate_renderings: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Joshua and all Israel turned back to Debir and besieged it,
alternate_renderings: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Pay attention to yourself, lest you make a covenant with those settled on the land into which you are entering, lest it become a stumbling block among you.
alternate_renderings: Take heed to yourself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you go, lest it be for a snare in the midst of you:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Ahaziah was twenty years old when he reigned, and one year he reigned in Jerusalem, and his mother’s name was Athaliah daughter of Omri.
alternate_renderings: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Jethro was amazed at all the good things that the Lord had done for them, that he had rescued them from the hand of the Egyptians and from the hand of Pharaoh.
alternate_renderings: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall not profane my holy name, and I shall be sanctified in the midst of the sons of Israel. I am the Lord who sanctifies you,
alternate_renderings: Neither shall all of you profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the one eating from their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening, and the one carrying from their carcasses shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
alternate_renderings: And he that eats of the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that bears the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Jehoshaphat king of Judah said to the king of Israel, Ask the Lord today.
alternate_renderings: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray you, at the word of the LORD to day.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, If a person from among you brings gifts to the Lord, you shall bring your gifts from the livestock, from the cattle and from the sheep.
alternate_renderings: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, all of you shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Into your hand the Lord gave the leaders of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. And what was I able to do like you? Then their spirit toward him relaxed when he spoke this word.
alternate_renderings: God has delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was decreased toward him, when he had said that.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Cursed is whoever takes gifts to strike the life of innocent blood. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
alternate_renderings: Cursed be he that takes reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and every wild beast according to kind, and all the cattle according to kind, and every creeping thing moving on the earth according to kind, and every bird according to its kind,
alternate_renderings: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Not one word fell from all the good words that the Lord spoke to the sons of Israel; all came to pass.
alternate_renderings: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And now know and see what you will do, because evil has been completed against our lord and against his house, and he is a pestilent son, and no one can speak to him.
alternate_renderings: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the one entering into the house all the days during which it is isolated shall be unclean until evening.
alternate_renderings: Moreover he that goes into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And when he heard that I lifted my voice and cried, leaving his garments beside me, he fled and went outside.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And servants of Hadarezer saw that they had fallen before Israel, and they made covenant with David and served him. And Syria did not want to help sons of Ammon anymore.
alternate_renderings: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he said to his sons, Saddle the donkey for me. And they saddled the donkey for him, and he mounted it.
alternate_renderings: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and I was not counted worthy to kiss my children and my daughters. But now you acted foolishly.
alternate_renderings: And have not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? you have now done foolishly in so doing.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the days were fulfilled for her to give birth, and she had twins in her womb.
alternate_renderings: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall keep all my law and all my commands and do them. I am the Lord your God.
alternate_renderings: Therefore shall all of you observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And a great mixed company went up with them, and sheep and cattle and very much livestock.
alternate_renderings: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and we have brought other money with us to buy food. We do not know who put our money into our bags.
alternate_renderings: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Boaz said, On the day of your acquiring the field from the hand of Naomi, and from Ruth the Moabitess, wife of the dead man, it is necessary for you also to acquire her for yourself, so as to raise up the name of the dead over his inheritance.
alternate_renderings: Then said Boaz, What day you buy the field of the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, If any man's wife goes astray and in overlooking overlooks him,
alternate_renderings: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The nakedness of your sister, from your father or from your mother, homeborn or born outside, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
alternate_renderings: The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or daughter of your mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness you shall not uncover.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall bring in the table and arrange its arrangement, and you shall bring in the lampstand and place its lamps.
alternate_renderings: And you shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and you shall bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Whatever each person sins against his neighbor, and if he takes upon himself a curse to curse him, and comes and declares openly before your altar in this house,
alternate_renderings: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before yours altar in this house:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And now when this letter comes to you, with you are the sons of your lord, and with you are the chariot and horses and fortified cities and weapons.
alternate_renderings: Now as soon as this letter comes to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: If perhaps the Lord will look upon my humiliation and return to me good instead of his curse on this day.
alternate_renderings: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.
